commonDescription:
Looks up a key in reference or context data and returns the matching string or XML. A map path separated
by `/` performs chained lookups; numeric keys can also match reference-data ranges.
commonReturnDescription: The matching value or XML nodes, or an empty sequence if no value is found.
name: lookup

args.description: The reference data map name, or `/`-separated map path.
args.name: map

args.description: The effective time in `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSXX` format. Omit to use the stream's receive time.
args.name: time

args.description: Suppress warnings for failed lookups when `true`.
args.name: ignoreWarnings

args.description: Output additional trace information as `INFO` messages when `true`.
args.name: trace
